# Sofia

> Sofia is a community-curated map of the web, built on the Intuition protocol. People recommend web pages by taking an on-chain position on them; every recommendation is public, dated and owned by the person who made it. Sofia shows which pages people back, who spotted them first, and which pages credible accounts follow.

Sofia has three parts: a Chrome extension (recommend any page with a right-click), the Explorer (browse what the community recommends), and Spotters (a monthly ranking of the people who find pages early).

## Key concepts

- **Recommend**: a position on the claim "I recommends <page>" on the Intuition protocol (TRUST token). Signed-in users get free Recommends every month; the position belongs to them and can be withdrawn.
- **Oppose**: a position against a page's recommendation.
- **Tags**: why a page is recommended (for work, for learning, for fun, for inspiration, for buying, for music) and its topics.
- **Spotted page**: a page where an account was among its first 3 recommenders, then at least 5 credible accounts followed.
- **Influence**: the summed credibility of the accounts that followed someone onto pages they spotted. The monthly Top 10 by Influence shares a TRUST pool.
- **Credible account**: an account with a positive trust score in Intuition's trust graph.

## Explorer

- [Explore](https://explorer.sofia.intuition.box/explore): the community feed and top voices by topic
- [Trending](https://explorer.sofia.intuition.box/trending): pages gaining recommendations in the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days
- [Spotters](https://explorer.sofia.intuition.box/spotters): how spotting works, the monthly ranking and the pages spotted this month

## Get started
